_comment: AI Works skill registry — tracks installed plugins and active skill versions

skill_overrides._comment: Map of base skill name → plugin name that overrides it. Set by the install process.

ab_tests._comment: Skill A/B test configuration — agent randomly or deterministically receives variant A or B

_schema.variant_a: path to variant A SKILL.md (usually the original)
_schema.variant_b: path to variant B SKILL.md (the candidate)
_schema.traffic_split: fraction sent to variant B (0.0 to 1.0)
